name: Codex
limitations: After each update, manually check that every profile shows its own account; some app-server versions may ignore CODEX_HOME.

verifiedOn.by: ai-multi-instance (upstream report, not local account QA)

seo.title: Multiple Codex App Accounts on Windows
seo.description: Run Codex profiles side by side with a separate CODEX_HOME and Electron data path. Check account isolation after every app update.
seo.intro: Codex profiles set CODEX_HOME and CODEX_ELECTRON_USER_DATA_PATH before launching the official Store app. This separates desktop state and CLI sessions; check the visible account in every profile after an update.
